findings.title: Phase 4 gate overdue day counts stale across 6 docs (41→48 days, 2026-07-15→2026-07-22)

Actual count as of 2026-07-22 is 48 days overdue. Also: elapsed counter '55 days' should be '62 days'; as-of date '2026-07-15' should be '2026-07-22'.
findings.fix_sketch: Update all '41 days overdue' → '48 days overdue', '55 days elapsed' → '62 days elapsed', and 'as of 2026-07-15' → 'as of 2026-07-22'.
